provider: Project Alexandria - Cloudflare's recurring OSS credit programme

free_tier.stated: Recurring annual credits, amount set per project. Explicitly includes 'Increased R2 storage for builds and artifacts' and 'Increased requests to Cloudflare Workers and Pages'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: R2 egress is free to the internet; Workers/Pages requests are included in the credit.

tooling: R2 is S3-compatible (rclone 's3' with Cloudflare provider, aws CLI, wrangler). Pages via git/wrangler deploy.
chaining: Annual renewal is the whole point: unlike the one-shot startup credits, this is stated as 'recurring annual credits'. A maintainer with several OSS projects can plausibly hold several grants; credits are per project, non-transferable.
limits_note: Must 'maintain an open source project with a recognized OSS license' and 'operate solely on a non-profit basis'. Requires a payment method on file. Acceptance and amount are at Cloudflare's sole discretion; programme can be discontinued at any time.
